text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT — inference-prod: sudden spike in 5xx errors and elevated P95 latency. Alert triggered: inference_5xx_rate > 2% (5m). Paging: @Maria @Ashok. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/inference-5xx

Maria: on it. grabbing context panels now — which service is noisy? model-routing or runtime?

Ashok: runtime nodes showing ~3.8% 5xx across the pool, lots of backpressure in the queue. I see concurrent GC spikes on gpu-node-07 around the same time.

Maria: ok. immediate mitigation: 1) scale inference-pool by +20% 2) flip fallback to smaller-quant model for high-latency tenants 3) throttle non-prod clients. I'll do scale now.

Ashok: +1. Also let's disable batching for 2m for affected nodes to see if queueing is the culprit.

Maria: running scale command:
```bash
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool inference-pool --delta 4
```

deploy-bot: scale action started by Maria. JobID: job-9246. Expected ready ~90s.

Jake: FYI for the postmortem/dashboard work — we should add a temporary incident dashboard with these panels: overall 5xx rate, per-model 5xx, P95 latency, queue depth, GPU mem pressure, GC pause histogram. Need drilldowns to traces and the per-request logs.

Sana: agree. Also add a golden-signal row at the top: error rate (5xx), latency (P95), saturation (GPU util), traffic (req/s). If we tune alerts we should make thresholds per-namespace, not global. Global rules caused a noisy page last quarter.

Maria: scale completed. nodes warmed, 5xx dropping from 3.8% -> 1.1% in the last minute. Throttle applied to non-prod clients. Disabling batching on affected nodes now.

Ashok: confirm — after disabling batching P95 dropped by ~80ms. GC spikes persisted on node-07; I'm cordoning and will drain it for inspection.

Maria: good. customer impact: SRE telemetry shows 2 customer-facing requests/min failed during peak (mostly best-effort tenants). No major outage to paying customers. I'll flag product-ops for follow-up.

Jake: for alert tuning proposal (post-incident):
```
- change inference_5xx_rate rule to use rolling 10m avg (reduce flapping)
- split rule by model_namespace tag
- add suppression window during planned rollouts via annotation
- add a secondary alert for sustained P95 increase > 200ms for 10m
```

Sana: and add a noise filter: ignore small namespaces with <50r/s for error-rate alerts, route them to a low-priority channel.

Maria: creating the incident dashboard now. Quick sketch of panel set in grafana:
```json
["panels": [
  {"title": "5xx rate (overall)", "query": "sum(rate(requests_total{code=~\"5..\"}[1m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[1m]))"},
  {"title": "P95 latency", "query": "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))"},
  {"title": "Queue depth", "query": "sum(sfc_queue_depth)"},
  {"title": "GPU mem pressure", "query": "avg(gpu_memory_used_percent) by (node)"}
]]
```

Maria: adding quick links on the dashboard for drilldowns: traces (jaeger): https://tracing.redwood/trace?q={{trace_id}}, logs: https://logs.redwood/query?q={{request_id}}

Ashok: thanks. I'll open an issue for the node-07 investigation and attach GC flamegraph and nvidia-smi output.

Sana: for the retro, suggest these action items: alert-rule parameterize by namespace, add per-model alerting, add suppression annotation for deployments, and a compact golden-signals strip at top of PROD dashboard.

Maria: assigning follow-ups: @Ashok -> node-07 deep-dive (ticket INF-3221), @Jake -> dashboard PR with drilldowns and panels (PR link when ready), @Sana -> alert-rule changes proposal. I'll schedule a 30m post-incident review at 15:30.

deploy-bot: Incident marked as mitigated by Maria. Mitigation summary: scaled pool +20%, disabled batching temporarily, cordoned node-07.

Maria: closing note — no widespread customer impact. Will run the retro and push dashboard + alert changes as follow-ups. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
